description: Research r15 (AWS box 1, 8x B200, two runs per GPU; dev only): r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 (A 001 + fp32 master weights at lr 1e-6, zero-advantage rows skipped, training reward 0 for malformed or truncated outputs) step-capped at 800 steps (budget_steps), with the cosine decay to 0.1x over those 800 steps (each step counts as 21.75 s of the 17,400-s budget), so a run follows the same trajectory on any GPU or GPU share. r5's three H100 seeds collapsed at steps 350-550; 800 steps is about what a searching run of this recipe would do in 5 h on an H200. vllm_gpu_memory 0.2 and micro_batch_tokens 4096 fit two fp32 runs on one B200 (the update is the same). Control.
